implementation_values_g2.A_belief: PCS2b cache A_belief is v_A; follow-A means pred == f(v_A) with f = identity for readback and + m for future m
implementation_values_g2.X: random.Random(f'20261022:{state id}').choice of digits != v_A; fixed per state, so train/val/test states each have their own X
implementation_values_g2.gate: per slot k: MLP(2048 + 1 + 10 -> 512 -> GELU -> 1 + 2048) on [prefix_k / rms, a, a * onehot(X)]; output prefix_k * (1 + s_k) + delta_k * rms; last layer zero-initialised so G starts as the identity; rms = the frozen bridge's embedding RMS scale
implementation_values_g2.gate_inputs_note: G sees the prefix, a and a*onehot only; it never sees B's text, so a=0 'no note' and a=0 'spoof' are indistinguishable to G (the spoof gains no authority by construction)
implementation_values_g2.loss: digit-restricted cross entropy over B's ten digit logits (PCS2b logits_with_prefix); B and bridge frozen in fp16/fp32 as in PCS2b
implementation_values_g2.prompt_only: chat system message with the frozen instruction sentence; same user text and prefix as NO-GATE; the authority flag has no effect (no gate)
implementation_values_g2.queries: readback plus future m = 1..9 (10 queries, all train/test); during training each (state, condition) is paired with one query, query index (state_ordinal + 3 * condition_index + epoch) % 10
implementation_values_g2.statistics: mon2_contract.cluster_bootstrap_mean over test states (10k, seed 0); mon2_contract.exact_mcnemar (Fraction-based) on (state, query) pairs, GATE vs NO-GATE
implementation_values_g2.val_selection: val states x 4 conditions x 3 queries ((ordinal + condition_index + 3j) % 10, j = 0,1,2); score = mean over the four conditions of mean CE; minimum over epochs
implementation_values_g2.verified_text: 'Verified: v = X' exactly as INTERFERE1 (i1.note_text 'strong_conflict' / 'strong_agree'), placed after P and before the state insertion marker
